description: Looks after one WhatsApp number, named by id. action sync refreshes the number’s state, quality rating and limits from Meta and returns the connection. action recheck_payment is for a person who added a payment method in Meta after a number was blocked for payment: it asks Meta again and returns the connection (adding the method itself happens in Meta’s own tools). Owners and admins for sync. Disconnecting a number is an owner’s or admin’s step in the Cosend dashboard.

action.description: sync reads the number’s state from Meta. recheck_payment asks Meta again after a payment method was added.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: manage_number
title: Refresh or re-check a number
